title: pteridium aquilinum subsp. japonicum
intro: Pteridium aquilinum subsp. japonicum, commonly known as Japanese bracken, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dennstaedtiaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting liver function. The therapeutic actions of Japanese bracken include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit potential antiviral, antifungal, and anticancer activities, making it a promising subject for further research.
